sources.grain: One exact product / platform / collection / processing stream. A satellite with multiple products has multiple source rows.

columns.name: Human-readable name.
columns.provider: Organization/service that supplies the data or model.
columns.kind: Data family: hotspots, masks, geolocation, land cover, imagery, weather or reports.
columns.platform: Terra, Aqua, S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, Landsat mission, or null for non-satellite sources.
columns.instrument: MODIS, VIIRS, Landsat instrument, or null when not applicable.
columns.collection: Exact product collection/version; use an explicit documented not-applicable value if needed.
columns.processing_stream: Standard, NRT, reanalysis, forecast, or another explicitly named source stream.
columns.documentation_url: Official product or provider documentation link.
columns.citation: Attribution/citation text to show in evidence and exports.
columns.license_info: Applicable access/reuse terms and attribution requirements.
columns.native_resolution_m: Documented nominal/native spatial scale in metres; does not guarantee event-location accuracy.
columns.schema_version: Version of the data contract used to interpret this record.
columns.metadata: Versioned source-specific metadata, including units and derivation where relevant.

assets.grain: One immutable input file or API response revision. Store the bytes in file/object storage and their identity here.

columns.source_id: FK to the exact product specification in sources.
columns.revision: Provider or locally assigned immutable content revision.
columns.source_url: Original retrieval address; credentials must never be embedded.
columns.storage_uri: Internal file/object address of preserved bytes.
columns.sha256: SHA-256 digest of the immutable artifact or content named in this row.
columns.time_start: UTC beginning of source observation coverage.
columns.time_end: UTC end of source observation coverage.
columns.footprint: Actual spatial support when known; not an invented precise location.
columns.retrieved_at: UTC timestamp when the source was fetched.
columns.validation_status: Pending check, accepted input, or quarantined failure.
columns.metadata: Versioned source-specific metadata, including units and derivation where relevant.

data_releases.grain: One frozen, publishable combination of inputs, code and scientific configuration.

columns.name: Human-readable name.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.stream: Retrospective, provisional, or experiment; avoids silently mixing standard and NRT.
columns.code_version: Reproducible code identifier: commit hash or saved source-bundle digest.
columns.manifest_uri: Location of the immutable input/output inventory.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.
columns.published_at: UTC time of release publication, not a news publication time.
columns.parent_release_id: Previous snapshot from which unchanged partitions can be reused.
columns.dataset_kind: Satellite, weather or report snapshot; components are pinned separately.
columns.scope_key: Registered served geography/data scope, not an arbitrary user polygon.
columns.observation_cutoff: Declared event-time cutoff for this snapshot; not proof of complete local observation coverage. Weather forecasts retain their own later valid times.
columns.validation_report_uri: Publication gate results and inventory completeness evidence.

release_assets.grain: One input asset included in one release with a declared role.

columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.asset_id: FK to the immutable input file/API response in assets.
columns.role: Purpose of the linked asset in this context.

pipeline_runs.grain: One execution of a processing stage; supports retries and reproducibility.

columns.release_id: Optional output release; early acquisition can run before a release exists.
columns.stage: Named pipeline operation, such as decode_masks or build_calendar.
columns.idempotency_key: Deterministic identity preventing duplicate processing requests.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.code_version: Reproducible code identifier: commit hash or saved source-bundle digest.
columns.input_manifest_uri: Manifest of exact input records/assets and their versions.
columns.output_manifest_uri: Manifest of the outputs written by this processing run.
columns.error_code: Machine-readable failure code; detailed redacted logs live separately.

areas.grain: One immutable geographic selection or named AOI revision.

columns.name: Human-readable name.
columns.geom: WGS84 geometry used for location/intersection queries; metric areas are calculated separately.
columns.geometry_sha256: Digest of normalized geometry used for cache/version identity.
columns.display_timezone: IANA civil display zone, e.g. Africa/Casablanca; not the raw data time basis.
columns.provenance: Drawn polygon, reviewed boundary source, or other geometry provenance.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.

grids.grain: One fully specified analysis grid and land-mask version.

columns.projection_srid: Equal-area projection identifier; initial Morocco proposal is EPSG:6933.
columns.cell_size_m: Proposed 5000 m initially; other grid sizes require separate versions.
columns.origin_x_m: Fixed grid origin easting in the projected CRS.
columns.origin_y_m: Fixed grid origin northing in the projected CRS.
columns.supported_extent: Documented geographic extent within which this grid/product is supported.
columns.land_mask_asset_id: FK to the reviewed land mask input asset.
columns.construction_spec: Axis convention, rasterization, land-mask rules, CRS and nodata specification.

grid_cells.grain: One cell of an analysis grid. Area is calculated in its equal-area projection.

columns.id: Unique row identifier. Generated identity value.
columns.grid_id: FK to the grid definition in grids.
columns.grid_x: Integer column index under the fixed grid origin.
columns.grid_y: Integer row index under the fixed grid origin.
columns.geom: WGS84 geometry used for location/intersection queries; metric areas are calculated separately.
columns.area_m2: Total geometric cell area in square metres.
columns.land_area_m2: Land portion of the cell in square metres.

area_cells.grain: One AOI/cell intersection under a weighting method; contains land-only overlap.

columns.area_id: FK to the immutable AOI revision in areas.
columns.cell_id: FK to the analysis grid cell in grid_cells.
columns.overlap_land_area_m2: Square metres of land shared by this AOI and cell; aggregation weight.

detections.grain: One native hotspot record in a canonical input asset. It is not a unique fire incident.

columns.id: Unique row identifier. Generated identity value.
columns.asset_id: First canonical input asset for this record; later sightings remain in fetch/input manifests.
columns.source_id: Exact normalized platform/product source. A combined MODIS asset can contain both Terra and Aqua sources.
columns.native_record_key: Stable row/pixel identity within the preserved asset.
columns.geom: WGS84 geometry used for location/intersection queries; metric areas are calculated separately.
columns.confidence_raw: Unchanged native numeric/category confidence stored as text.
columns.confidence_scheme: Product-specific confidence definition; not a universal probability.
columns.type_raw: Native thermal-source classification, null when unavailable.
columns.day_night: Native day/night flag mapped to a documented enum.
columns.frp_mw: Fire radiative power in megawatts; zero may be valid and flagged.
columns.brightness_bands: Array/object recording exact band, brightness-temperature value and unit; no cross-band equivalence assumed.
columns.scan_km: Footprint width only where documented in km; null for incompatible native fields.
columns.track_km: Footprint length only where documented in km.
columns.cross_track_sample: Native sample index where supplied; do not substitute it for kilometres.
columns.native_fields: Remaining original fields and record locator, retained for auditing.
columns.record_sha256: Hash of canonical native record content plus source/identity rules; deduplicates repeated unchanged API rows across files.
columns.identity_key: Stable native pixel/granule identity if available; null if a defensible identity is unavailable.
columns.identity_method: Exact version of native-key or canonical-row hashing; never rounded-location fuzzy deduplication.
columns.processing_level: Standard, NRT, RT, URT or unknown from the actual record; feed name alone is insufficient.

observations.grain: One analysis cell × source product × satellite pass × QA policy in a data release.

columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.cell_id: FK to the analysis grid cell in grid_cells.
columns.source_id: FK to the exact product specification in sources.
columns.pass_key: Deterministic platform overpass identity after granule-overlap handling.
columns.time_start: UTC beginning of source observation coverage.
columns.time_end: UTC end of source observation coverage.
columns.representative_time: Documented representative actual acquisition time inside this cell/pass interval.
columns.local_solar_date: Cell-centre approximate local solar date under the release policy.
columns.regime: Declared observation regime, such as afternoon_day or morning_day.
columns.land_area_m2: Cell land support used by this QA computation.
columns.cloud_land_m2: Cloud/obscured land under the product-specific decoder.
columns.unobserved_land_m2: Land outside the available observation support.
columns.usable_support_uri: Exact geolocated usable mask/geometry needed to intersect two observations.
columns.detection_links_uri: Versioned mapping from contributing raw record IDs to retained/excluded detections and reasons.
columns.coverage_status: Usable, insufficient, missing input or outside swath.
columns.retained_detection_count: Retained detections on usable support; may be null if not computable.
columns.retained_any: Defined cell/pass response; null when ineligible, false only for a valid negative.
columns.eligible: Whether this opportunity meets the declared QA rules.
columns.exclusion_reasons: Structured reason codes for rejected or incomplete opportunities.
columns.qa_policy_version: Decoder, confidence, geometry and eligibility policy version.
columns.geometry_summary: Source viewing/solar geometry summaries with units and methods.

observation_assets.grain: One source-file link used to derive an observation, including non-detection support.

columns.observation_id: FK to the source cell/pass observation.
columns.asset_id: FK to the immutable input file/API response in assets.
columns.role: Purpose of the linked asset in this context.

matched_pairs.grain: One source/reference observation pair on the same cell and shared usable land, under a pairing series.

columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.cell_id: FK to the analysis grid cell in grid_cells.
columns.series_key: Identity of source/reference products, regime and matching-policy version.
columns.reference_observation_id: FK to the reference cell/pass; initially Aqua.
columns.source_observation_id: FK to the paired source cell/pass; initially S-NPP.
columns.time_delta_seconds: Absolute time separation used for the pairing eligibility rule.
columns.shared_usable_land_m2: Area of intersection of both usable land masks.
columns.shared_usable_fraction: Shared usable land divided by declared cell land area, 0–1.
columns.shared_support_uri: Geometry/mask of the actual shared support, not merely its area.
columns.eligible: Whether the pair meets all frozen comparison gates.
columns.reference_target: Reference retained-any detection on shared support; null for excluded pairs.
columns.source_any_on_shared_support: Common-grid baseline response, calculated on the same shared support.
columns.split_name: Frozen train, development, calibration, temporal test, spatial test or excluded assignment.
columns.episode_group_id: Group tying neighboring observations of the same likely episode together.
columns.exclusion_reasons: Structured reason codes for rejected or incomplete opportunities.

feature_sets.grain: One frozen feature dataset and split manifest. Actual feature rows live in Parquet.

columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.artifact_uri: File/object-storage location of the immutable dataset or model.
columns.sha256: SHA-256 digest of the immutable artifact or content named in this row.
columns.feature_contract: Predictor names, units, derivations, missing-value policy and serving availability.
columns.split_manifest_uri: Immutable membership of temporal/geographic train/dev/calibration/test groups.
columns.split_sha256: Digest of the frozen split manifest.
columns.row_count: Number of feature rows in the artifact.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.

model_versions.grain: One fitted model version for a declared source-to-reference response and support domain.

columns.name: Human-readable name.
columns.feature_set_id: FK to training features and frozen split definitions.
columns.source_id: FK to the exact product specification in sources.
columns.reference_source_id: FK to the exact target reference product.
columns.artifact_uri: File/object-storage location of the immutable dataset or model.
columns.sha256: SHA-256 digest of the immutable artifact or content named in this row.
columns.target_definition: Precise response, regime, grid, confidence rule and shared-support definition.
columns.support_domain: Validated geography, seasons, streams, coverage and feature-domain limits.
columns.calibration_manifest_uri: Probability calibration procedure, artifact and disjoint calibration set.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.

evaluations.grain: One model × release × experiment × evaluation slice.

columns.model_id: FK to the fitted model version.
columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.experiment: Temporal holdout, geographic holdout, withheld-Aqua replay, sensitivity, etc.
columns.split_manifest_uri: Immutable membership of temporal/geographic train/dev/calibration/test groups.
columns.positive_count: Positive reference responses among those opportunities.
columns.independent_block_count: Independent blocks/episodes supporting the reported score.
columns.metrics: Defined metrics with units, null handling and uncertainty where computed.
columns.baseline_metrics: Metrics for an appropriate baseline on exactly the same evaluated support.
columns.uncertainty_method: Block bootstrap, empirical error range, or explicitly not estimated.
columns.report_uri: Location of the reproducible evaluation report.

predictions.grain: One model result for one source observation; unsupported results have null probability.

columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.cell_id: FK to the analysis grid cell in grid_cells.
columns.observation_id: FK to the source cell/pass observation.
columns.model_id: FK to the fitted model version.
columns.response_probability: Estimated reference retained-detection response, 0–1; not probability of a real fire.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.features_uri: Exact feature row used for this prediction.
columns.uncertainty: Documented empirical uncertainty information and method, or null when not estimated.

daily_activity.grain: One cell/day/metric/policy in a release, including unsupported or missing cell-days.

columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.cell_id: FK to the analysis grid cell in grid_cells.
columns.reporting_date: Cell reporting day under the declared time basis.
columns.time_basis: Versioned UTC/solar/civil-day policy; initial comparable product uses local solar day.
columns.selection_policy: Fixed eligible-source/pass priority; does not maximize fire response.
columns.observation_id: FK to the source cell/pass observation.
columns.prediction_id: FK to the selected prediction for an inferred response; null for direct reference.
columns.response_value: Observed 0/1 or supported model probability; null for unavailable states.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.candidate_count: Number of opportunities considered before deterministic selection.
columns.reasons: Structured quality/support explanations for the result.

analyses.grain: One immutable user selection and analysis configuration, with job/cache state.

columns.area_id: FK to the immutable AOI revision in areas.
columns.release_id: FK to the frozen dataset/configuration in data_releases.
columns.time_basis: Reporting-day definition shared by relevant outputs.
columns.grid_id: Analysis grid for comparable metrics; null is allowed for a native-detection-only request.
columns.baseline_spec: Frozen baseline years/season/support rules, or null if unavailable.
columns.weather_policy: Selected source models, variables, dates, weighting and freshness policy.
columns.news_policy: Date-aware discovery, review and source-matching policy.
columns.cache_key: Hash of all immutable inputs/settings that determine the result.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.error_code: Machine-readable failure code; detailed redacted logs live separately.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.
columns.completed_at: UTC timestamp when processing completed; null while pending.
columns.request_spec: Canonical request including source IDs, data mode, baseline/filter versions, authorization scope and component choices.

calendar_periods.grain: One reporting period within a saved analysis; stores numerator and denominator explicitly.

columns.analysis_id: FK to the saved user selection in analyses.
columns.period_start: Inclusive beginning of the reporting period.
columns.period_end_exclusive: Exclusive end date of the period.
columns.resolution: Day, week, month or full selection.
columns.response_numerator_m2_days: Sum of eligible AOI land weights times daily response; not burned area.
columns.eligible_land_m2_days: Eligible AOI land-area-days; denominator of the comparable response.
columns.possible_land_m2_days: Total AOI land area times reporting days; coverage denominator.
columns.response_value: Generated numerator / eligible denominator; null at zero eligible support. Calculated by PostgreSQL.
columns.coverage_fraction: Generated eligible / possible area-days, 0–1. Calculated by PostgreSQL.
columns.observed_weight_fraction: Eligible weight contributed by directly observed reference, versus estimated source.
columns.valid_cell_days: Eligible cell-days contributing to the period.
columns.baseline_year_count: Number of supported comparable historical years; zero when no baseline.
columns.seasonal_percentile: Baseline percentile only after the minimum-baseline policy passes.
columns.uncertainty: Documented empirical uncertainty information and method, or null when not estimated.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.reasons: Structured quality/support explanations for the result.

weather_locations.grain: One native weather grid cell, station or declared sampling point.

columns.source_id: FK to the exact product specification in sources.
columns.native_location_key: Stable source grid-cell or station identity; preserve returned coordinates.
columns.support_kind: Native grid cell, station, or explicitly sampled point.
columns.geom: WGS84 geometry used for location/intersection queries; metric areas are calculated separately.
columns.footprint: Actual spatial support when known; not an invented precise location.
columns.elevation_m: Provider/model elevation in metres, with metadata for any adjustment.
columns.native_resolution_m: Documented nominal/native spatial scale in metres; does not guarantee event-location accuracy.
columns.metadata: Versioned source-specific metadata, including units and derivation where relevant.

weather_values.grain: One weather variable/location/interval from a particular input asset revision.

columns.id: Unique row identifier. Generated identity value.
columns.location_id: FK to the native weather location or sampling point.
columns.source_id: FK to the exact product specification in sources.
columns.asset_id: FK to the immutable input file/API response in assets.
columns.variable: Canonical variable name, including height/depth where relevant.
columns.unit: Explicit normalized unit for this variable/statistic.
columns.valid_start: UTC start of the measurement/aggregation interval.
columns.valid_end: UTC end; may equal start for instantaneous values.
columns.issued_at: Forecast model-run issue time; required for forecasts.
columns.available_at: When this value was actually available, if known; needed for historical real-time replay.
columns.data_kind: Reanalysis, forecast, model_current or station_observation. Model current values are not station measurements.
columns.statistic: How the value relates to its interval: instant, sum, mean, etc.
columns.value: Numeric value in the declared unit; null represents unavailable/invalid data.
columns.quality_status: Valid value, missing input, or rejected value.
columns.derivation: Native unit, conversion, de-accumulation, model and original record locator.

weather_summaries.grain: One area/period/variable/source statistic within a saved analysis.

columns.analysis_id: FK to the saved user selection in analyses.
columns.source_id: FK to the exact product specification in sources.
columns.variable: Canonical variable name, including height/depth where relevant.
columns.unit: Explicit normalized unit for this variable/statistic.
columns.period_start: Inclusive beginning of the reporting period.
columns.period_end: Exclusive end of the reporting period.
columns.statistic: How the value relates to its interval: instant, sum, mean, etc.
columns.value: Numeric value in the declared unit; null represents unavailable/invalid data.
columns.spatial_method: Area-weighted native-grid statistic or explicitly labelled sample-point context.
columns.spatial_weights_uri: Versioned weights/locations used for the AOI, including coverage geometry.
columns.input_manifest_uri: Manifest of exact input records/assets and their versions.
columns.temporal_coverage_fraction: Fraction of required time support with valid values, 0–1.
columns.spatial_coverage_fraction: Fraction of required spatial support represented, 0–1.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.reasons: Structured quality/support explanations for the result.

news_reports.grain: One retrieved document revision and extraction version, separate from events it describes.

columns.asset_id: FK to the immutable input file/API response in assets.
columns.canonical_url: Normalized publisher link, excluding tracking parameters.
columns.title: Document headline; untrusted source text, not an instruction.
columns.language: Language code, initially en/fr, optionally ar.
columns.published_at: UTC publication timestamp if known; preserve its precision.
columns.publication_precision: Precision of publication time; preserve day-only or unknown timestamps.
columns.retrieved_at: UTC timestamp when the source was fetched.
columns.content_sha256: Digest identifying the retrieved document version.
columns.summary: Short permitted synopsis, not a copied full article.
columns.original_reporting_url: Original reporting link when this article is a republication.
columns.syndication_group: Shared reporting lineage used to avoid counting copies as independent evidence.
columns.source_lineage: Whether the report is field-based, official, satellite-derived, mixed or unknown.
columns.review_status: Whether a human checked the extraction or rejected it.

reported_events.grain: One event claim extracted from a report. Different reports may describe the same event.

columns.report_id: FK to the exact document/extraction revision.
columns.claim_index: Stable event-claim position within that report.
columns.event_start: Earliest supported event date, not the publication date.
columns.event_end_exclusive: Exclusive end of the supported event-date interval.
columns.date_precision: Precision of the reported event date: day, interval, month, unknown, etc.
columns.place_text: Original place description in the report.
columns.location: Point or region representing the report’s actual geographic precision.
columns.location_precision: Exact location, town, province, country, unknown, etc.
columns.event_cluster_key: Optional reviewed grouping of reports about the same event; not a satellite incident count.
columns.reported_event_type: Type claimed by the report, not inferred from a MODIS type code.
columns.reported_burned_area_ha: Area as reported by the source; never calculated from hotspot count.
columns.reported_cause: Attributed cause claimed by the report, preserved as a claim.
columns.claim_summary: Plain synopsis of the extracted event claim.
columns.review_status: Whether a human checked the extraction or rejected it.
columns.reviewed_by: Reviewer identifier, not an inferred credibility score.

analysis_event_links.grain: One assessed link between an analysis and a reported event under a matching method.

columns.analysis_id: FK to the saved user selection in analyses.
columns.event_id: FK to the extracted report event.
columns.relation: Candidate, consistent, conflicting, unresolved or rejected match.
columns.temporal_match: Matched intervals, tolerances and temporal uncertainty.
columns.independence: Whether this source adds independent evidence or reuses satellite data.
columns.evidence_note: Reason for the assessed relationship; no automatic universal confirmation.
columns.reviewed_by: Reviewer identifier, not an inferred credibility score.

evidence_snapshots.grain: One immutable, bounded bundle of facts, statuses and source citations for an analysis.

columns.analysis_id: FK to the saved user selection in analyses.
columns.schema_version: Version of the data contract used to interpret this record.
columns.evidence_json: Bounded facts with IDs, values, units, statuses, source links and exact versions.
columns.sha256: SHA-256 digest of the immutable artifact or content named in this row.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.

ai_explanations.grain: One explanation attempt for a snapshot, question, model, prompt version and language.

columns.snapshot_id: FK to the immutable facts supplied to the model.
columns.language: Language code, initially en/fr, optionally ar.
columns.question: User question for this selection; sanitized for display and treated as user input.
columns.provider: Organization/service that supplies the data or model.
columns.model_id: Actual language-model identifier used, separate from scientific model_versions.
columns.tool_contract_version: Version of allowed read-only tools and schemas.
columns.output_json: Structured answer, per-claim evidence IDs, limitations and suggested checks.
columns.status: Explicit lifecycle/result state; permitted values appear in the constraints below.
columns.validation_report: Results of fact, citation, scope, unit and limitation checks.
columns.tool_trace_uri: Redacted tool inputs/outputs used for reproducibility, not private model reasoning.
columns.input_tokens: Recorded provider input usage if available.
columns.output_tokens: Recorded provider output usage if available.
columns.cache_key: Hash of all immutable inputs/settings that determine the result.
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when this record was created.
columns.completed_at: UTC timestamp when processing completed; null while pending.

metric_definitions.grain: One versioned measurement contract; raw detections and comparable responses use distinct units.

columns.id: Stable version-qualified metric identifier referenced by analyses/daily_activity.
columns.unit: detections, dimensionless_reference_response, or another explicit unit.
columns.family: Native detections, source response or harmonized response.
columns.definition: Formula, eligible support, aggregation/time rules, uncertainty and allowed data streams.
columns.requires_masks: Whether local QA/geolocation is needed to calculate this metric.
columns.requires_model: Whether calibrated source inference is part of this metric.

ingestion_feeds.grain: One external transport adapter; MODIS_NRT is one feed that yields Terra and Aqua records.

columns.endpoint_template: Redacted URL template with placeholders; never store actual MAP_KEY in a URL.
columns.credential_ref: Secret manager/environment variable name, never the secret value.
columns.rate_limit_group: Shared quota bucket, e.g. the same FIRMS account across all sources.
columns.capability_spec: Verified maximum window, pagination, coverage, latency class and source documentation.
columns.state: Active, paused, retired or not yet verified.

feed_sources.grain: One exact source emitted by a feed, with the predicate that selects its rows.

columns.source_id: FK to sources; output product can differ from a combined transport asset source.
columns.selector: Platform/product discriminators and mappings; MODIS Terra and Aqua are separated here.

source_availability.grain: One dated provider availability observation for a feed/source; records retained for audit.

columns.available_start: Earliest reported event/valid time; may be unknown.
columns.available_end_exclusive: End of reported available interval, exclusive; not a local cloud-coverage claim.
columns.status: Available, partial, unavailable, unknown or retired.
columns.evidence_asset_id: Optional immutable response proving this availability result.
columns.detail: Gaps, endpoint response, documented retirement and product version notes.

ingestion_subscriptions.grain: One configured feed × registered scope × acquisition mode; public map clicks do not create it.

columns.area_id: FK to the acquisition polygon used for bounding-box tiles and later clipping.
columns.interval_seconds: Proposed polling frequency; not provider observation frequency.
columns.overlap_seconds: Time deliberately re-requested to catch late data.
columns.history_start: Earliest event/update time this subscription manages.
columns.fixed_end_exclusive: Optional bounded end for historical imports.
columns.request_config: Sources, variables, collection IDs, chunking, backoff and endpoint-specific settings.
columns.enabled: False until credentials, inventory and scope have passed readiness checks.
columns.next_due_at: Earliest scheduled next poll in UTC.
columns.lease_owner: Worker identity holding a temporary lock.
columns.lease_expires_at: When another worker may recover an abandoned subscription.

fetch_runs.grain: One bounded external query attempt; complete means retrieval succeeded, not that nature was fully observed.

columns.request_key: Hash of feed, scope, window, request parameters and scheduled poll generation; retry keeps it stable.
columns.attempt: Attempt number within that request key, beginning at one.
columns.query_start: Inclusive lower bound in the declared query basis.
columns.query_end_exclusive: Exclusive upper bound in the declared query basis.
columns.query_basis: Observation time, provider revision time, publication time or model initialization time.
columns.sanitized_request: Exact request and pagination parameters with credentials redacted.
columns.status: Queued, running, complete, partial, failed or validated not-modified.
columns.enumeration_complete: All required pages/chunks resolved; empty data alone does not establish completeness.
columns.record_count: Parsed returned count; zero is a valid successful empty payload.
columns.started_at: UTC start time of this attempt.
columns.completed_at: UTC finish time of this attempt.
columns.max_observation_at: Latest event time actually present; null for an empty response.
columns.http_status: Last HTTP response status, if applicable.
columns.retry_after: Next allowed retry after provider limit/backoff.

fetch_assets.grain: One immutable response/file associated with a fetch attempt and page; includes successful empty responses.

columns.asset_id: FK to preserved bytes or a validated previously cached asset.
columns.role: Catalog page, payload, empty result, availability or cached payload.

ingestion_checkpoints.grain: One committed progress marker per subscription/stage; does not infer progress from the last detection.

columns.stage: Discovery, fetch, normalization or publication checkpoint.
columns.cursor_basis: Exact meaning of committed_until, such as successfully queried UTC end.
columns.committed_until: Contiguous committed boundary; do not advance over unresolved gaps.
columns.cursor_json: Provider cursor state scoped to a fixed request; long-lived revision watermark is explicit.
columns.last_success_run_id: Fetch evidence for the committed boundary.
columns.generation: Optimistic concurrency version used for compare-and-swap updates.

ingestion_gaps.grain: One unresolved or resolved interval of ingestion availability; distinct from clouds/no-detection.

columns.gap_start: Inclusive start of the unavailable/query-failed interval.
columns.status: Open, retrying, resolved or explicitly accepted unavailable.
columns.discovered_at: UTC first detection of this gap.
columns.resolved_by_run_id: Fetch run that supplied missing evidence, when resolved.
columns.evidence: Failure response IDs, missing granule keys and resolution explanation.

quality_issues.grain: One rule violation produced by a pipeline execution; blocking issues prevent publication.

columns.pipeline_run_id: FK to the execution that found the issue.
columns.asset_id: Optional FK to affected raw input.
columns.status: Open, resolved or reviewed/accepted with explanation.
columns.affected_count: Count of affected records or objects.
columns.sample_locator: Bounded sample of row/granule locators without copying large data.

data_partitions.grain: One immutable complete snapshot of one series/partition key; empty snapshots are allowed.

columns.pipeline_run_id: FK to the run producing this partition.
columns.kind: Detection, observation, feature, daily product, weather, report or tile output.
columns.series_key: Product/stream or method series; publication resolves overlap explicitly.
columns.partition_key: Deterministic date/spatial shard key within a series.
columns.support_spec: Exact half-open time/spatial bounds, input completeness, stream and selection rules.
columns.input_manifest_uri: Exact raw input assets/rows and processing policies.
columns.schema_version: Version of the partition row schema.
columns.row_count: Canonical output records, zero for an authoritative empty snapshot.
columns.serving_complete: True only when all rows required by the bounded serving contract are in database tables; false requires lake-backed queries.
columns.created_at: UTC time the partition revision was produced.

partition_detections.grain: One canonical detection included in a served detection partition.

columns.partition_id: FK to a complete detection partition revision.
columns.detection_id: FK to the immutable normalized detection record.

release_partitions.grain: One selected revision per series/partition key in a release; unchanged partitions can be shared.

columns.series_key: Series being published; part of unique selection key.
columns.partition_id: FK to the selected matching series/key partition revision.

partition_dependencies.grain: One derived partition dependency used to find downstream rebuild work.

columns.partition_id: FK to the derived output partition.
columns.role: Input role, such as detections, mask, weather or geolocation.

release_aliases.grain: One mutable pointer to a published release for a named scope; readers pin its resolved UUID.

columns.alias: latest_standard, latest_recent, latest_weather_history, latest_weather_recent or latest_reports.
columns.release_id: FK to the published snapshot currently selected.
columns.generation: Compare-and-swap generation preventing concurrent publishers overwriting each other.

release_changes.grain: One documented scoped change between two published snapshots.

columns.affected_area: Affected geography if known; null means scope-wide/unknown.
columns.reason: New, late, revised, standard replacement, retraction, method/weather/report change.
columns.diff_manifest_uri: Counts, changed partition IDs and canonical added/removed/changed record evidence.

analysis_components.grain: One pinned satellite/weather/reports snapshot or explicit missing component per analysis.

columns.analysis_id: FK to the immutable user request.
columns.component: Satellite, historical weather, recent weather or reports.
columns.release_id: Exact context release, nullable when that component is unavailable/not requested.
columns.status: Ready, partial, missing, unsupported, failed or not requested.

api_jobs.grain: One durable asynchronous API job with request identity and export lifecycle.

columns.id: Unique job identifier returned to the client.
columns.kind: Analysis, explanation, export, backfill or explicit refresh.
columns.requested_by: Authenticated principal/session scope used for authorization and idempotency.
columns.request_hash: Canonical request digest; same idempotency key with different hash returns conflict.
columns.idempotency_key: Client-supplied or server-generated key unique within requester scope.
columns.request_spec: Validated bounded job configuration, with secrets excluded.
columns.status: Queued, running, succeeded, partial, failed or cancelled.
columns.attempt: Worker attempt count; jobs are retried idempotently.
columns.lease_expires_at: When an abandoned running job can be reclaimed.
columns.progress: Completed/total work units, stage and warnings; no fabricated ETA.
columns.expires_at: Export retention/download expiry, distinct from scientific data retention.

outbox_events.grain: One durable work/publication event committed in the same database transaction as its state change.

columns.event_type: Versioned event name, e.g. release.published or analysis.requested.
columns.aggregate_id: Related job/release/analysis ID; validated by event type.
columns.dedupe_key: Stable event identity for at-least-once delivery.
columns.payload: Minimal typed job IDs/config references, no credentials.
columns.status: Pending, leased for dispatch, or delivered.
columns.delivered_at: Broker-confirmed dispatch time, not job completion.
